planSteps.description: Fill out 'Nombre' with 'Moderador QA', 'Correo electrónico' with a random email ending in '@testsprite.test', and 'Contraseña' with 'Test1234!', then submit the form.
Select the 'Soy voluntario / particular' card, fill out the P2P onboarding form with alias 'moderador-qa', phone '3000000000', and submit.
Find an offer (e.g. 'Oferta Especial [TEST]' or any available offer) and click the report (flag) button.
Fill out the report reason with '[TEST] Reporte automático de prueba' and submit.
Verify a success message is shown indicating the report was sent.
